excludes: International flights, travel insurance, Pakistan visa fee, personal trekking gear/sleeping bag/crampons, and staff tips; helicopter rescue not covered by staff insurance.

Dedicated Baintha acclimatisation day with gradual altitude gain built in
Includes Thuraya satellite phone, weather forecasts and GPS tracking
Mandatory technical glacier gear specified (crampons, ice axe, harness, helmet)

cons: Lower porter allowance (15 kg main bag, 5 kg day pack) than rivals' 20 kg
Tips of ~£140/US$175 into a group fund expected on top

verdict: A UK-operator, financially-protected 22-day trip with an international leader, full technical-gear requirements and good comms, but a tighter 15 kg porter limit and a summarised itinerary.
excludes: International flights, travel/trekking insurance, Pakistan visa, Islamabad lunches/dinners, personal equipment and clothing, and tips (~£140/US$175 group fund).
